header.running_head: The Practices of Nabi ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) with Regard to Clothing

blocks.text: The Practices of Hadhrat Salmaan (RA), Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) and Hadhrat Ali (RA) with Food and Drink

Hadhrat Saalim says, "I was with my master Zaid bin Sowhaan when Hadhrat Salmaan Faarsi (RA) passed by us after purchasing a Wasaq of grain. 'O Abu Abdullaah!' Zaid called out, 'You are doing this (buying so much) when you are the companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ?' Hadhrat Salmaan (RA) replied, 'The soul is at ease when it has secured its sustenance. It can then free itself for Ibaadah and Waswaas (the devil that whispers evil into the heart) loses hope in (adversely influencing) it.'" [^1]
Hadhrat Abu Uthmaan Nahdi narrates that Hadhrat Salmaan Faarsi (RA) said, "I love to eat from the efforts of my own hands." [^2]
Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) once said, "I had fifteen dates so I broke my fast with five, ate Sehri with five and kept the other five to break my fast with." [^3]

Hadhrat Muslim who was the freed slave of Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) says, "When Hadhrat Ali (RA) once asked for a drink, I brought him a cup of water and blew into it. He refused to drink it and returned it to me saying, 'You drink it.'" [^4]
The Practices of Nabi ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) with Regard to Clothing

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla says that he was once with Hadhrat Umar (RA) when he said, "I saw Abu Qaasim (Rasulullaah) ﷺ wearing a narrow-sleeved cloak made in Shaam." [^5]

Hadhrat Jundub bin Makeeth (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ wore his best clothing whenever he received a delegation and would instruct the senior Sahabah (RA) to do the same. On the day a delegation arrived from Kindah tribe, I saw Rasulullaah ﷺ wearing clothing made in Yemen and both Abu Bakr (RA) and Umar (RA) were wearing the same." [^6]
Hadhrat Salamah bin Akwa (RA) says that Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)'s loincloth always reached halfway up his calves and he would say, "Such was the garment of my beloved (Nabi) ﷺ." [^7]
